value.text: I noticed one in-package test builds a zero-value DB struct for pure helper testing in auth_config_test.go—let me look at that file more closely, along with user_delete_test.go and similar files.

h04.

No — the only place the MySQL driver is constructed is the driver-selection factory. `mysql.NewDB(...)` is called exactly once in the whole repository, inside the `switch` in `NewDBDriver`:

```18:27:/bench/repo/store/db/db.go
	switch profile.Driver {
	case "sqlite":
		driver, err = sqlite.NewDB(profile)
	case "mysql":
		driver, err = mysql.NewDB(profile)
	case "postgres":
		driver, err = postgres.NewDB(profile)
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("unknown db driver")
	}
```

Evidence gathered:

- A repo-wide search for `mysql.NewDB` / `mysql.DB` (references to the `store/db/mysql` package from outside it) returns only `store/db/db.go` lines 8 and 22. Likewise, `store/db/db.go` is the only file outside `store/db/mysql/` that imports `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql`.
- All driver acquisition elsewhere goes through the factory: `cmd/memos/main.go:57`, `store/test/store.go:28` and `:50`, and `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go:70` all call `db.NewDBDriver(profile)`. The test helper only picks the driver name and DSN (`store/test/store.go`, `getTestingProfileForDriver`), leaving construction to the factory.
- Two other matches on "mysql" outside the package are unrelated to the memos driver: `store/test/containers.go` imports the testcontainers module `testcontainers-go/modules/mysql` (for `mysql.Run`, spinning up a MySQL container) and the low-level `github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql` package. Neither constructs `store/db/mysql.DB`.
- The one direct construction of the struct is inside the package itself, in a unit test: `db := &DB{}` at `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`, a zero-value instance used only to call the pure helper `IsRetryableAuthenticationMutationError`. It never opens a connection.

For contrast, SQLite is constructed directly outside the factory in two store tests (`store/demo_seed_test.go:24`, `store/deployment_config_test.go:416`), so the "factory only" property is specific to MySQL and Postgres.
